stem.text: The stoichiometry of a catalysed reaction is shown by the equation below.
Two experiments are carried out in which the amount of $R$ is measured. The results are shown in the diagram.

stem.alt: Graph of amount of R against time with two curves: experiment 1 rises and levels off at a higher plateau; experiment 2 rises more slowly and is still rising at the end of the time shown.

stem.text: Which changes in the conditions could explain the results shown?

items: A lower pressure was used in experiment 2.
A different catalyst was used in experiment 2.
Product S was continuously removed from the reaction vessel in experiment 2.
